name: The Owner
notes: a caricature of the real owner of The Sour Pickle Cafe: a cheerful middle-aged East Asian woman with a large caricatured head and a small body, short dark brown hair with a soft fringe swept back off the face, fine rimless wire-frame glasses, one small gold hoop earring, a wide open delighted grin showing her teeth, laugh lines around the eyes, wearing a bright magenta-pink short-sleeved t-shirt under a deep burgundy-red bib apron with a small gold embroidered emblem on the chest and a front pocket, warm and welcoming, always mid-gesture
